LineInfantry Description: Extends the tech tree of all four races into the gunpowder era: Arquebus, Heavy Musket, Flintlock and Rifled Musket, with volley-fire line tactics.
li_arquebus_description: The dawn of the gunpowder age. A slow reload traded for a single shot that tears through old leather armor.
li_musket_description: A heavy matchlock built to punch through the thickest plate. Big bore, slow reload, terrifying power.
li_flintlock_description: Flint ignition and paper cartridges double the rate of fire. Musketeers now rely on volley fire, not luck.
li_rifled_description: Rifling meets the Minié ball: doubled effective range. The dense line is both thunder and swan song.
craftPriority Description: Cultures prefer to craft muskets when forging weapons.
spawnWithMusket Description: New recruits of developed cities spawn with the musket tier matching the city's size.
